title: Add a digital licence or credential to the Service NSW app
summary: Learn how to add various digital licences and credentials, such as your driver licence or trade certificates, to the Service NSW app.
who_can_apply: Must have a MyServiceNSW Account to log in to the Service NSW app.
For the RSA/RCG Competency Card, your email address must be the same for both the card and your MyServiceNSW Account.
what_you_need: A smartphone with the Service NSW app installed (download or update it).
The specific licence or credential you wish to add.

faqs.q: How do I add a licence or credential to the Service NSW app?
faqs.a: Download the Service NSW app, log in with your MyServiceNSW Account details, select 'Wallet' from the homescreen, and then tap the 'Add' button to follow the prompts.

faqs.q: Do I need to carry a physical card for all my licences?
faqs.a: You must carry your physical card when operating a personal watercraft at any speed, and when you are working with a trade licence, certificate, or training card.

faqs.q: What licences can I add to the Service NSW app?
faqs.a: You can add licences and credentials such as the NSW Digital Driver Licence, Boat driving licence, Recreational fishing licence, RSA/RCG Competency Card, Seniors Card/Senior Savers Card, and trade licences/certificates.
